name: Aviation-Benchmark
description: Civil aviation maintenance is a domain characterized by stringent industry standards. Within this field, maintenance procedures and troubleshooting represent critical, knowledge-intensive tasks that require sophisticated reasoning. To address the lack of specialized evaluation tools for large language models (LLMs) in this vertical, we propose and develop an industrial-grade benchmark specifically designed for civil aviation maintenance.
reputation: A newly proposed vertical benchmark for civil aviation maintenance that is mainly of interest to domain-specific LLM evaluation rather than a broadly established community standard.
notes: Likely small and specialized, with limited public adoption so far; performance may depend heavily on aviation-domain knowledge and terminology.
